---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible diagnostic or compatibility issue
labels: bug
---

## Version and environment

Tool version, Python version, OS, and relevant gateway settings:

## Sanitized command

Remove credentials and private endpoint details before posting.

## Expected and observed behavior

Include probe names, statuses and finding codes. Review JSON reports before sharing: origins and selected model names can be sensitive.

## Minimal synthetic reproduction

Use synthetic content rather than customer prompts or raw confidential responses. Describe whether the same behavior occurs with the local demo.

## Safety check

I have checked that this issue contains no API key, private data or unreviewed provider response body.
